summary: Crypto derivatives exchange and yield platform whose flexUSD stablecoin generated returns through the CoinFLEX repo market before withdrawals were suspended in June 2022 following a major counterparty shortfall and the business entered a Seychelles court-approved restructuring.
what_happened: CoinfloorEX was spun out and relaunched as CoinFLEX in early 2019. The exchange later added a centrally traded repo market and launched flexUSD, an interest-bearing stablecoin whose backing was deployed into that market. CoinFLEX suspended withdrawals on 23 June 2022, citing extreme market conditions and uncertainty involving a counterparty, then allowed limited withdrawals in July. Liquidity Technologies applied for restructuring in Seychelles and its scheme of arrangement was approved in March 2023. Customer recoveries have involved partial withdrawals, scheme asset allocations and equity claims through a dedicated creditor portal, while related recovery litigation and administration remain ongoing.
uncertainty_notes: The February 2019 launch date uses the first day of the month because the relaunch source identifies only the month. The scheme was approved, but the reviewed sources do not establish a final universal recovery percentage or a completed end to all creditor administration and litigation.
notes: Added as an exchange-linked yield and restructuring case. The record focuses on CoinFLEX customer balances, flexUSD and related lending products rather than treating the exchange as a generic trading venue only.
